summary: Secure replacement rules deny all client writes and use live server-owned roles. Emulator tests passed on the first reviewed commit. Live project access, legacy function retirement, production identity provisioning, UI/LINE end-to-end and deployment remain release gates; this is not a live-project security certification.

findings.issue: The original branch rules allowed public users reads and unauthenticated point/role updates. Actual deployed rules could not be read because Firebase Console requires sign-in.
findings.recommendation: After backup and coordinated client migration, publish the replacement rules and verify the deployed release. Never deploy the legacy public directory.

findings.issue: Previously deployed admin reset/reward HTTP endpoints and schedulers may bypass the new month gate through Admin SDK.
findings.recommendation: Inventory and retire or migrate every legacy writer before enabling POS auto-awards.

findings.issue: Real LINE login, isolated cloud Firebase writer, and production backup/restore remain unverified.
findings.recommendation: Complete these checks using dummy accounts and a separate Firebase project before owner release approval.
